sources.title: Ministerio del Interior fortalece lucha contra la trata de personas con un convenio de cooperación internacional
sources.subject: Tim Ballard, Red Rock Foundation
sources.summary: Paraguay's Interior Ministry signed a cooperation agreement with the Red Rock Foundation to combat human trafficking, signed by Interior Minister Enrique Riera Escudero and Red Rock Foundation representative Matthew Norman Cooper; Timothy Ballard attended as part of an accompanying international delegation.

sources.title: Disgraced Anti-Sex-Trafficking NGO Gets $244 Million to Rep Migrant Kids
sources.subject: Tim Ballard, O.U.R./Our Rescue, Derek Benner
sources.summary: O.U.R./Our Rescue received a no-bid $244,034,658 federal contract (awarded 2026-08-07) to provide legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children in ORR custody -- about 7x the org's 2025 assets ($36.9M). Recaps Ballard's 2023 resignation amid assault/trafficking allegations and his $566,993 final-year salary; current CEO Derek Benner ($413,387 salary) previously ran ICE's 'Operation Paper Chase' sting. Cites SAM.gov award notice, Form 990 filings, a federal court order (Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin), and prior reporting by The Appeal on a Haiti orphanage where O.U.R.-'rescued' children were allegedly abused.

sources.title: Facebook post reacting to O.U.R.'s $244M federal contract award
sources.byline_role: Lead plaintiffs' counsel, Ballard civil litigation
sources.subject: Tim Ballard, O.U.R./Our Rescue, M. Russell Ballard
sources.summary: Public attorney statement (not reporting) from Ballard plaintiffs' lead counsel, sharing/reacting to the American Prospect contract story. Characterizes Ballard's pre-O.U.R. background and M. Russell Ballard's role in elevating him, recaps the 'Couples Ruse' and misconduct allegations, and argues the new $244M contract is incongruous given O.U.R.'s scandal history. Contains claims beyond the Prospect article (failed CIA polygraph, Haiti/Colombia entrapment allegations) that are counsel's characterization and would need independent sourcing before being presented as established fact.
